scenarios.title_zh: Visa TAP 9002 端口对齐、CORS 去重、mTLS 证书绑定与 Nonce 防重放守卫
scenarios.title_en: Visa TAP Port 9002 Parity, CORS Deduplication, mTLS Binding & Nonce Anti-Replay Guard
scenarios.reason: TAP populate_sample_data.py error message port (9000) must match BASE_URL port 9002 (trusted-agent-protocol#20).
scenarios.remediation: Align error diagnostic port with BASE_URL port 9002 and deduplicate CORS origins.

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe Cursor 生命周期钩子、51 项 pytest-asyncio 全量发现与 2026-10-31 rak_* 守卫
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Cursor Lifecycle Hooks, 51-Test pytest-asyncio Discovery & 2026-10-31 rak_* Guard
scenarios.reason: Cursor plugin must register PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, SessionStart, and beforeSubmitPrompt hooks (agent-toolkit#576).
scenarios.remediation: Register all 4 Cursor lifecycle hooks for feedback injection, skill telemetry, and CLI guidance.

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe Action 40-Hex SHA 锁定、Metronome 钩子、strands-agents 与 mcp<2.0.0 守卫
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Workflow 40-Hex SHA Pin, Metronome Hook, strands-agents & mcp<2.0.0 Guard
scenarios.reason: sync-agent-plugin workflow must pin GitHub Actions to 40-hex commit SHAs per SAT-31061 (agent-toolkit#552).
scenarios.remediation: Replace mutable version tags with full 40-character commit SHAs in workflow files.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP Order MCP 绑定 get_order 消息签名与身份关联候选逐一发现守卫
scenarios.title_en: UCP Order MCP get_order Message Signing & Per-Candidate Identity Discovery Guard
scenarios.reason: UCP Order MCP binding (get_order) must sign requests and business responses with JSON-RPC id/params binding matching Order REST (ucp#988).
scenarios.remediation: Attach Detached JWS / RFC 9421 signature metadata on Order MCP get_order requests and responses.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 延期分期拆单支付（completion_only 约束）与 5 类标准履约事件守卫
scenarios.title_en: UCP Split Payments Across Deferred Schedules & Standardized Fulfillment Events Guard
scenarios.reason: Instrument 'pi_giftcard' is declared charge_timing='completion_only' and cannot fund a deferred payment schedule (ucp#987).
scenarios.remediation: Assign completion_only instruments exclusively to immediate completion charges and fund deferred schedules with schedule-capable instruments.

scenarios.title_zh: ACP CheckoutSessionWithOrder allOf order 字段放行与 PaymentHandler.display_order 嵌套守卫
scenarios.title_en: ACP CheckoutSessionWithOrder allOf order Allowance & PaymentHandler.display_order Guard
scenarios.reason: CheckoutSessionWithOrder must allow the sibling 'order' field without CheckoutSessionBase additionalProperties: false rejecting it (acp#290).
scenarios.remediation: Use unevaluatedProperties: false or explicit order property allowance on CheckoutSessionWithOrder.

scenarios.title_zh: Google AP2 签名授权书一致性语料库、跨语言验证器与 EC 收据公钥 JWK.from_pyca 守卫
scenarios.title_en: Google AP2 Mandate Conformance Corpus, Second-Language Verifier & EC Receipt Key Guard
scenarios.reason: Hardcoded FakeJWT or unsigned placeholder mandate tokens are forbidden (AP2#371, #369).
scenarios.remediation: Sign mandates with sd_jwt.create / kb_sd_jwt.create and verify against contrib/mandate-corpus/ fixtures.

scenarios.title_zh: Google AP2 敏感支付日志脱敏、多跳 ~~ 委托链末跳隔离与结账哈希强制绑定守卫
scenarios.title_en: Google AP2 Sensitive Log Redaction, Multi-Hop ~~ Delegation & Checkout Hash Binding Guard
scenarios.reason: AP2 servers and processors must not log sensitive payment payloads, tokens, mandates, or risk_data (AP2#364).
scenarios.remediation: Disable include_payloads=True on FastMCP LoggingMiddleware and log only body-free status/count diagnostics.

scenarios.title_zh: Google AP2 JSON 模式枚举序列化、dSD-JWT ~~ 解码、原子消费预留与终端 aud/nonce 守卫
scenarios.title_en: Google AP2 JSON Enum Dump, dSD-JWT ~~ Decoder, Atomic SQLite Reserve & Terminal aud/nonce Guard
scenarios.reason: delegate_claims_from_model() must use model_dump(mode='json') so Frequency enums serialize as strings instead of raising TypeError (AP2#355).
scenarios.remediation: Dump Pydantic mandate claim models with mode='json' before SD-JWT disclosure hashing.

scenarios.title_zh: A2A-x402 Mist 乐观批量结算保证金、支付后产出公证、Interline 非托管路由与 Nano PoW 守卫
scenarios.title_en: A2A-x402 Mist Batch Bond, Post-Payment Provenance, Non-Custodial Interline & Nano PoW Guard
scenarios.reason: scheme_exact_mist batch settlement requires operator escrow bond >= epoch net total and >= 6-hour challenge window before bond release (a2a-x402#172).
scenarios.remediation: Enforce operator bond collateralization and a minimum 6-hour challenge window on Base batch epochs.

scenarios.title_zh: Coinbase AgentKit SwapChan 授权回执等待与 Chord 确定性路由/滑点底线守卫
scenarios.title_en: Coinbase AgentKit SwapChan Approval Receipt Wait & Chord Deterministic Router/Slippage Guard
scenarios.reason: SwapChan quote action must rank between 1 and 5 routes by net output (agentkit#1586).

scenarios.title_zh: Coinbase AgentKit Python MCP 扩展显式白名单/错误脱敏与 viem ^2.47.4 单副本守卫
scenarios.title_en: Coinbase AgentKit Python MCP Explicit Allowlist/Error Sanitization & viem ^2.47.4 Guard
scenarios.reason: Python AgentKit MCP extension must enforce explicit action allowlisting, input schema validation, and sanitized error responses (agentkit#1583).
scenarios.remediation: Reject non-allowlisted AgentKit actions over MCP, validate tool inputs, and scrub raw tracebacks from error responses.

scenarios.title_zh: Coinbase AgentKit TAP Labs 交易前防火墙与 ncrypted AES-256-GCM 一次性阅后即焚密钥守卫
scenarios.title_en: Coinbase AgentKit TAP Labs Pre-Trade Wallet Firewall & ncrypted One-Time Secret Link Guard
scenarios.reason: tapLabsActionProvider requires pre-trade check_token_safety (<= $0.01 USDC), check_transaction Wallet Firewall (<= $0.02 USDC), and OFAC/scam clearance before execution (agentkit#1580).
scenarios.remediation: Run TAP Labs Safety Check and Wallet Firewall before signing trades and block OFAC/honeypot targets.

scenarios.title_zh: Coinbase AgentKit Triqee $0.001 微支付/FlashFlow、CrewPay 60/15/25 分润与 HirePulse 无钱包隔离守卫
scenarios.title_en: Coinbase AgentKit Triqee $0.001/FlashFlow, CrewPay 60/15/25 Split & HirePulse Wallet-Less Guard
scenarios.reason: Triqee get_leadlag_divergence x402 fee must be <= $0.001 USDC on Base and simulate_flashflow must run before routing (agentkit#1571).
scenarios.remediation: Cap Triqee lead-lag x402 micropayment at $0.001 USDC and require FlashFlow pre-trade simulation.

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra tau2-bench voice-v1 canonical_tasks=True 重载与 Windows LF 冻结子集哈希守卫
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench voice-v1 canonical_tasks=True Reload & Windows LF Frozen-Subset Hash Guard
scenarios.reason: voice-v1 reload_call_language (in run_simulation and tau2 evaluate-trajs) must pass canonical_tasks=True so English retail/telecom pins match canonical registry tasks (tau2-bench#673).
scenarios.remediation: Pass canonical_tasks=True when reloading voice-v1 language bindings and exports.

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra tau2-bench 零售同款换货拒绝、电信空字符串 MMSC URL 拦截与黄金动作一对一匹配守卫
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench Same-Item Exchange Reject, Empty MMSC URL & 1-to-1 Gold Action Matching Guard
scenarios.reason: exchange_delivered_order_items must reject new_item_id == item_id with 'The new item id should be different from the old item id' (tau2-bench#667).
scenarios.remediation: Reject same-item exchanges in exchange_delivered_order_items matching modify_pending_order_items.
